entry.title: Preparing Agriculture for a New Era of Extreme Weather
entry.summary:

entry.title: The United Nations in a Time of Opportunity & Uncertainty: a Time to Choose
entry.summary:
DELHI, India, July 29 (IPS) - On 15 September 1953, Vijaya Lakshmi Pandit of India was elected the eighth president of the UN General Assembly — the first woman to hold the UN’s second-highest position. Since then, only four women have followed her, most recently the current president, Annalena Baerbock. Since its founding, the UN has had nine Secretaries-General. All men. Now, 81 years after the UN’s founding, we have a historic opportunity to correct that record. It is time to entrust the UN leadership to a woman of the Global South who shapes a more inclusive, effective and forward-looking UN.

Read the full story, “The United Nations in a Time of Opportunity & Uncertainty: a Time to Choose”, on globalissues.org →
